purpose: Buscar pagos positivos entre apuestas existentes, sin inventar cuotas de combinadas.

mathematics.portfolio: Nonnegative straight-bet stakes summing to the stated budget.
mathematics.strict_cover: Positive net payout in every feasible outcome.
mathematics.weak_cover: Nonnegative net payout in every outcome and positive in at least one feasible outcome; refund can yield zero.
mathematics.expected_value: A profitable historical sample or a cover with losing outcomes does not prove positive true expected value.
mathematics.correlation: Settle every leg on the SAME coherent event state. Do not multiply correlated marginal probabilities or invent same-match parlay prices.

scope_limits: Available datasets only: not every football price ever offered or a currently executable betting board.
No bets, deposits, paid subscriptions or bookmaker account execution.
Betfair sample LTP is last traded price, not an available offer; it is excluded from executable-quote cover claims.
SharpAPI small mixed-provider snapshot is inventoried but not normalized into this temporal portfolio search.
Player-event dependencies, unknown participant/void rules, exchange lays, boosts and unquoted BetBuilder combinations are not claimed exhaustively searched.
